n = int(input())
b = int(input())

nums = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

oddCountArr = [0] * n
evenCountArr = [0] * n

if nums[0] % 2 == 0:
    evenCountArr[0] = 1
else:
    oddCountArr[0] = 1

for i in range(1, n):
    if nums[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCountArr[i] = evenCountArr[i - 1] + 1
        oddCountArr[i] = oddCountArr[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCountArr[i] = oddCountArr[i - 1] + 1
        evenCountArr[i] = evenCountArr[i - 1]

costList = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    if evenCountArr[i] == oddCountArr[i]:
        costList.append(abs(nums[i] - nums[i + 1]))

costList.sort()
totalCostUsed = 0
maxCutsPossible = 0
for cost in costList:
    if totalCostUsed + cost <= b:
        totalCostUsed += cost
        maxCutsPossible += 1
    else:
        break

print(maxCutsPossible)
